query:
insert into passkey_enrolments
                 (tenant_id, session_id, csrf_digest, challenge, expires_at)
             values ($1, $2, $3, null, $4)
             on conflict (tenant_id, session_id) do update
                set csrf_digest = excluded.csrf_digest,
                    challenge   = null,
                    expires_at  = excluded.expires_at
